name: Flohmarkt Ulm Messe

rhythm.de: Ein Wochenende im Jahr, Samstag und Sonntag
rhythm.en: One weekend a year, Saturday and Sunday

facts: indoor, in the hall at Messe Ulm
second-hand only — new goods are not wanted
sellers must book in advance; smallest stall 2 metres
stall 11 € a metre in the middle of the hall, 15 € along the wall; tables to rent at 10 €
one of a chain of markets the organiser runs across southern Germany
notes: The organiser's Ulm page lists only this one weekend (07. and 08.11.2026), so 'rhythm' says what the page shows, not a stated frequency. Visitor entry fee is not stated. The page names the venue only as 'Ulm-Messe' and shows a map; the street address and coordinates come from the geocoder for Messe Ulm, Böfinger Straße 50.

description.de: Ein Wochenende im Jahr füllt sich die Halle der Messe Ulm mit Gebrauchtem — Neuware ist nicht erwünscht. Samstag und Sonntag jeweils 10 bis 16 Uhr. Die Stände müssen vorab gebucht werden, der kleinste misst zwei Meter.
description.en: One weekend a year the hall at Messe Ulm fills with second-hand goods — new stock is not wanted. Saturday and Sunday, 10 to 4 both days. Stalls must be booked in advance; the smallest is two metres.
